_stage-coverage-xml.//: Copies the most-recent coverage.cobertura.xml from each test project into the raw datasets directory, named {ProjectName}.xml. Covers both standard test projects (tests/core|extensions|misc|integration) and per-example runs produced by Flowthru.Tests.Examples:test:all (TestResults/{ExampleName}/).

commands: mkdir -p examples/advanced/FlowthruCoverage/Data/_01_Raw/Datasets && for dir in tests/core tests/extensions tests/misc; do for proj in $dir/*/; do name=$(basename $proj); latest=$(ls -t "$proj"TestResults/*/coverage.cobertura.xml 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$latest" ]; then cp "$latest" "examples/advanced/FlowthruCoverage/Data/_01_Raw/Datasets/${name}.xml"; echo "Staged: ${name}.xml"; fi; done; done && for entry in tests/integration/Flowthru.Tests.Examples/TestResults/*/; do name=$(basename "$entry"); xml=$(ls -t "$entry"coverage.cobertura.xml 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$xml" ]; then cp "$xml" "examples/advanced/FlowthruCoverage/Data/_01_Raw/Datasets/${name}.xml"; echo "Staged (example): ${name}.xml"; fi; done

run.//: Execute the Coverage pipeline. Depends on staged XML files — run _stage-coverage-xml first, or run run-with-staging to do both.

run-reporting.//: Execute the Reporting pipeline (generates coverage_heatmap.html). Requires package_coverage.csv to exist — run Coverage first.

run-with-staging.//: Stages coverage XMLs, runs the Coverage pipeline, then generates the HTML heatmap report.
